cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.26)
project("Auto-Framing")
list(APPEND CMAKE_MESSAGE_INDENT "[${PROJECT_NAME}] ")

streamfx_component_register("${PROJECT_NAME}"
	RESOLVER streamfx_auto_framing_resolver
)
streamfx_component_add_dependency("NVIDIA" OPTIONAL)

function(streamfx_auto_framing_resolver)
	# Providers
	#- NVIDIA
	streamfx_component_is_enabled("NVIDIA" T_CHECK)
	if(T_CHECK)
		target_compile_definitions(${COMPONENT_TARGET} PRIVATE
			PRIVATE ENABLE_NVIDIA
		)
	endif()
endfunction()
